gates.name: Every Encounter Resolves with a Receipt
gates.criteria: Every spawned encounter reaches exactly one terminal state within its declared maxTurns and has exactly one successfully applied aftermath receipt.

measurementMethod.numerator: count(distinct encounterId where terminalCount=1 and turnToTerminal<=maxTurns and appliedReceiptCount=1)
supportingChecks: no encounter accepts an action after terminal
no filled terminal clock remains active
no active encounter exceeds maxTurns
receipt commit key is unique

gates.name: Telegraph Coverage and Actionability
gates.criteria: At least 80% of spawned encounters render a pre-engagement STATUS, NPC, scene, item, or faction telegraph; every rendered cue maps to at least one legal action hook. Surprise encounters must satisfy their fairness exception.

supportingChecks: every cue actionHook exists in the stakes packet
elite encounters have at least two distinct channels
boss encounters have at least three distinct channels
surprise encounter has suspicion cue or reaction window
surprise opening severity is not above moderate

passThreshold.perRun: >=0.80 when run has five or more encounters; otherwise aggregate only

gates.name: Zero Wrong-Bible Spawns
gates.criteria: Every selected encounter and actor passes mode, bible, biome, site, faction reach, tier, prerequisite, exclusion, cooldown, and density-role checks.

measurementMethod.numerator: count(selected encounterId where all legality predicates are true)
supportingChecks: drought picker never overrides a hard rejection
empty candidate set uses legal fallback or content-gap receipt
all actors have world-map authority at the site
loot entries also pass biome provenance

gates.name: Density Targets Met
gates.criteria: Closed locations and chapters meet configured minimum and maximum role bands without saturation, duplicate one-shot crises, or cleared-node respawns.

profiles.dnd.keep.10-area: combat 3-5; trap 1-2; hazard 1-2; skill 2-4; puzzle 1-2; boss exactly 1
profiles.pyoa.chapter.60-turn: unique crisis 2-4; at least one commitment fork

supportingChecks: only terminal encounters count
no role exceeds configured maximum
no cleared node respawns without repopulation event
no one-shot crisis ID repeats
saturation and recovery guards hold

passThreshold.aggregate: >=0.95 of closed scopes pass during canary; 1.00 required before stable

gates.name: Aftermath Receipts Are Complete
gates.criteria: Every terminal encounter has at least two distinct nonempty receipt types and all receipt mutations reconcile with authoritative post-state.

measurementMethod.numerator: count(encounterId where distinct receipt types>=2 and every mutation reconciles and commitKey applied once)
supportingChecks: receipt beforeHash matches terminal ledger hash
receipt afterHash matches post-aftermath ledger hash
no duplicate XP or loot application
negotiated/fled/defeat terminals receive authored receipts

historicalRegressionFixtures.setup: Spawn a Tier-appropriate Summoned Pact combat with fight, flee, and parley visible; drive adversarial choices for 300 turns.
assertions: terminal turn is no greater than template maxTurns
flee or parley changes state on every accepted attempt
no action is accepted after terminal

historicalRegressionFixtures.setup: Traverse a 10-area Cursed Keep with no manually forced encounters.
assertions: DnD density minima include combat, trap or hazard, skill check or puzzle, and boss
each d20 action records die, modifier, target, and result

historicalRegressionFixtures.setup: Attempt Walk Away and the same leverage topic repeatedly during a Cape District confrontation.
assertions: Walk Away commits a terminal fled outcome and cooldown
leverage is consumed or discredited after one resolution
repeated unchanged leverage action is rejected without consuming a turn
a faction NPC or quest receipt persists

historicalRegressionFixtures.setup: Resolve Millstone Charter then advance through its convergence and ending gate.
assertions: one holder fact is true and the opposed fact is locked
the hearing callback differs by choice

reportShape.gateResults: array of gate ID, pass boolean, numerator, denominator, threshold, evidence
reportShape.overallPass: boolean; true only when every applicable gate passes
reportShape.contentGaps: array of bible, biome, role, rejected candidates and reasons
